summary:
[  edit  ]
The MQTT Client  DAT  receives and sends data from/to  MQTT  devices via MQTT servers (broker). TouchDesigner can act as a client and another computer needs to act as a MQTT Server.  Once a client establishes a connection with a server, it can do two things:
Send a message to the server to express interest in any data that has a specific "topic" string. This is called "subscribing". Then the MQTT Client  DAT  will receive all messages that the server gets with that topic.
Inform the server that it will send messages to the server with a certain topic string, and then send messages with that topic. The messages then get forward to any client that has expressed interest in that topic.
See also  MQTT ,  TCP/IP DAT .

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Enable the connection.

parameters.label: Network Address
parameters.name: netaddress
parameters.description: The address of the broker to connect to. The address should take the form  <protocol>://<host>:<port> . Accepted protocol URIs can include  tcp ,  ssl ,  ws , and  wss .

parameters.label: Specify ID
parameters.name: specifyid
parameters.description: Allows naming the client with parameter  User Client ID , otherwise automatically and uniquely generated for each connection.

parameters.label: User Client ID
parameters.name: usercid
parameters.description: Client name when  Specify ID  enabled.

parameters.label: Keep Alive Interval
parameters.name: keepalive
parameters.description: Specifies in seconds, the maximum time to expect without communication. If no data is sent during this time, a lightweight ping message is sent to the server instead. Can be set to 0 to avoid pings.

parameters.label: Max in Flight
parameters.name: maxinflight
parameters.description: Controls how many messages can be in-flight simultaneously.

parameters.label: Clean Session
parameters.name: cleansession
parameters.description: If  Specify ID  is selected, the server will preserve any state information associated with the connection of that ID, such as subscriptions, delivery attempts, etc.

parameters.label: Verify Certificate
parameters.name: verifycert
parameters.description: Enables TLS (transport layer security) certificate verification against the server (ie. broker).

parameters.label: Username
parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Specify the username for authentication if the server requires it. MQTT servers that support the MQTT v3.1 protocol provide authentication and authorization via username and password.

parameters.label: Password
parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Specify the password for authentication if the server requires it. MQTT servers that support the MQTT v3.1 protocol provide authentication and authorization via username and password.

parameters.label: Reconnect
parameters.name: reconnect
parameters.description: Will attempt to reconnect to the MQTT broker.

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: The Callbacks  DAT  contains functions that are called when connections are made, lost or published data arrives. See  mqttclientDAT_Class  for usage.

parameters.label: Execute from
parameters.name: executeloc
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines the location the script is run from.

parameters.label: Current  Node
parameters.name: current
parameters.description: The script is executed from the current node location (for example, where 'cc' points to).

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: The script is executed from the location of the  DAT  specified in the  Callbacks  DAT   parameter.

parameters.label: Specified  Operator
parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The script is executed from the operator specified in the  From  Operator   parameter below.

parameters.label: From  Operator
parameters.name: fromop
parameters.description: The operator whose state change will trigger the  DAT  to execute its script when  Execute From  is set to  Specified  Operator  . This operator is also the path that the script will be executed from if the  Execute From  parameter is set to  Specified  Operator  .

parameters.label: Clamp Output
parameters.name: clamp
parameters.description: The  DAT  is limited to 100 messages by default but with Clamp Output, this can be set to anything including unlimited.

parameters.label: Maximum Lines
parameters.name: maxlines
parameters.description: Limits the number of messages, older messages are removed from the list first.

parameters.label: Clear Output
parameters.name: clear
parameters.description: Deletes all lines except the heading. To clear with a python script  op( "opname" ).par.clear.pulse()

parameters.label: Bytes Column
parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: Outputs the raw bytes of the message in a separate column.

parameters.label: Language

parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.
